description: Engineering Council Sri Lanka - Engineering Council, Sri Lanka Act, No. 04 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Engineering Council, Sri Lanka under the Engineering Council, Sri Lanka Act, establishing regulatory requirements for electricians' qualifications and registration.
